points.title: 早年生活与教育
points.description: 克劳德·香农在密歇根州底特律出生并长大。他在底特律公立学校接受了基础教育，随后进入密歇根大学学习。在大学期间，他对数学和电子工程产生了浓厚的兴趣。1936年，他获得了电气工程学士学位。
points.descriptionEn: Claude Shannon was born in Detroit, Michigan, United States, and grew up there. He received his basic education from Detroit public schools and then attended the University of Michigan, where he developed an interest in mathematics and electrical engineering. In 1936, he earned a Bachelor of Science degree in electrical engineering.

points.title: 大学学习与博士学位
points.description: 香农在密歇根大学继续深造，1940年获得博士学位。他的博士论文题为《继电器与开关电路的符号分析》，这是信息论领域的开创性工作。这篇论文奠定了他在信息论领域的地位。
points.descriptionEn: Shannon continued his studies at the University of Michigan, earning his Ph.D. in 1940. His doctoral dissertation, titled 'A Symbolic Analysis of Relay and Switching Circuits,' was a groundbreaking work in the field of information theory, establishing his position as a leading figure in the field.

points.title: 信息论研究的起点
points.description: 香农在麻省理工学院工作，并在那里开始了他的信息论研究。他在1948年发表了《通信的数学理论》，这篇论文被认为是信息论的奠基之作，对通信工程和计算机科学产生了深远的影响。
points.descriptionEn: Shannon worked at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and began his research in information theory there. In 1948, he published 'A Mathematical Theory of Communication,' which is considered a foundational work in information theory and had a profound impact on communication engineering and computer science.

points.title: 信息论的发展与影响
points.titleEn: Development and Impact of Information Theory
points.description: 香农在美国多个地方工作和生活，继续他在信息论的研究。他的理论被广泛应用于通信、计算机科学、生物学和经济学等领域。香农的工作不仅改变了技术领域，也对整个社会产生了深远的影响。
points.descriptionEn: Shannon lived and worked in various locations across the United States, continuing his research in information theory. His theories have been widely applied in fields such as communication, computer science, biology, and economics. Shannon's work not only transformed the technical field but also had a profound impact on society as a whole.

supporter.zh: 香农被誉为信息时代的奠基人，他的信息论工作对现代通信和计算机科学的发展产生了深远的影响。他的理论为数字通信和存储技术的发展奠定了基础，被广泛认为是20世纪最伟大的科学家之一。
supporter.en: Claude Shannon is hailed as the founder of the information age, with his work in information theory having a profound impact on the development of modern communication and computer science. His theories laid the foundation for the development of digital communication and storage technology and are widely considered one of the greatest scientists of the 20th century.

critic.zh: 一些批评者认为香农的理论过于抽象，难以应用于实际问题的解决。此外，他的理论在某些情况下可能导致过度依赖技术，忽视了人类在信息处理中的角色。
critic.en: Some critics argue that Shannon's theories are too abstract and difficult to apply to the solution of practical problems. Additionally, his theories may lead to over-reliance on technology in certain situations, overlooking the role of humans in information processing.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，香农被视为信息论和通信理论的先驱，他的工作对后世的科学研究和技术发展产生了深远的影响。在大众文化中，他通常被描绘为一个天才科学家，但他的理论和方法论的复杂性往往被简化。
objective.en: In the historical perspective, Claude Shannon is regarded as a pioneer in information theory and communication theory, with his work having a profound impact on subsequent scientific research and technological development. In popular culture, he is often portrayed as a genius scientist, but the complexity of his theories and methodologies is often simplified.

others.zh: 香农的工作是数学和工程学的完美结合，他对我们理解信息世界的贡献是无法估量的。
others.en: Shannon's work is a perfect blend of mathematics and engineering, and his contribution to our understanding of the information world is immeasurable.
